episodes.title: Norway
episodes.summary: After lost luggage forces him to dress like a true local, Conan sets out to experience the best of Norway – including reunions with musician Jarle and fish farmer Kai, battles with some Vikings, and a unique tour of the Northern Lights.

episodes.title: Argentina
episodes.summary: In Buenos Aires, Conan takes on practice with a local football club, asado with Jordan Schlansky, and learns what it means to be a Gaucho.

episodes.title: Thailand
episodes.summary: Conan's mental and physical resolve are put to the test in Bangkok as he squares off against a Muay Thai fighter, a python and deep-fried scorpion.

episodes.title: Ireland
episodes.summary: While chasing his family's roots in Ireland, Conan endeavors to speak like a local, sing with The Irish Tenors, and act on a long-running soap opera.

episodes.title: Spain
episodes.summary: Conan picks olives with Jordan Schlansky, tries his hand in a flight simulator and takes in the best of Madrid with Javier Bardem.

episodes.title: New Zealand
episodes.summary: Conan attempts to break a world record with Taika Waititi and meets podcast fan Riley in his unique container home.

episodes.title: Austria
episodes.summary: After finally delivering a long overdue Team Coco shirt to a loyal fan, Conan performs with the Vienna Boys' Choir and channels his inner Freud.

episodes.title: India
episodes.summary: After riding Mumbai's legendary commuter train, Conan tackles the country's monkey problem and helps a fan launch a talk show.

episodes.title: The Netherlands
episodes.summary: After celebrating King's Day, Conan helps a fan's basketball team improve their trash-talking game and makes his own wooden shoe-venir.
